description: Bring a memory pack made by arroway_export INTO a project. Everything lands as a PROPOSAL for the person's review and nothing is pinned, whatever the pack says. If any part is malformed, nothing is imported.

pack.description: The pack document itself; this server does not fetch URLs.

project.description: Project slug. Not from the person or a read this session? It is a guess: check the arroway_catch_up roster.

name: arroway_import
title: Import a memory pack as proposals
